item.subject: Mathematics
item.stem: Which of these does NOT show a line of symmetry?

options.label: A
options.text: [Image: An arrow pointing up with a vertical double-headed line through its center]

options.label: B
options.text: [Image: A horizontally elongated symmetric shape with zigzag edges and a horizontal double-headed line through its center]

options.label: C
options.text: [Image: A triangle with a horizontal double-headed line passing through it]

options.label: D
options.text: [Image: A square with a diagonal double-headed line connecting two opposite vertices]

item.figure_description: Four shapes labeled A through D, each crossed by a straight line with arrowheads at both ends: A shows a vertically oriented block arrow pointing up, with a vertical line passing through the point of the arrow and the center of its base; B shows a horizontally elongated shape with zigzag top and bottom contours, with a horizontal line passing through the left and right tips; C shows a triangle with a horizontal line passing across it midway between the base and the top vertex; D shows a square with a diagonal line passing through the top-left and bottom-right corners.
item.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 1995 and 2003 fourth-grade mathematics data.

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 1995 and 2003 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 1995 and 2003 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it.

guessing.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 1995 and 2003 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's guessing (lower asymptote) parameter c: the probability that a student of very low ability answers it correctly, such as by guessing among the options? Choose the value closest to it.
